additional_context: Patient remains active in current core, but source/patient/list-Patient-operations.xml now lists only Patient-match and Patient-purge. Later FHIR-43373 application in commit 8085536f12e251d00b80ac47323658eb94e9b1ac removed the entire US Realm/meaningful-use minimum sentence from Patient $everything. Commit b487fdda4bb4a5382a93dbb5a811efd02425b9bc then moved PA operations out of core, deleted source/patient/operationdefinition-Patient-everything.xml, and changed current core references to the Administrative Incubator operation page. The current externally linked Patient $everything XML has no DAF, US Core, or US Realm minimum sentence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. Current core source has no authoritative Patient $everything OperationDefinition needing this edit, and the external operation currently referenced by core does not retain the stale DAF/link wording.
